services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Looking for a medium-sized room for an upcoming meeting? Or maybe you need several thousand feet of floor space with 38-foot ceilings for a dance? Book Your Event at Airbase Georgia Airpower Museum. Our hangar is over 10,000 square feet and provides you with a blank canvas to create your perfect space, with accommodation for up to 400+ guests. We’re are located at Atlanta Regional Airport, giving your guests a one-of-a-kind indoor/outdoor experience with front row views of the runway. We can also offer you and your guests warbird rides and other services… Great for weddings, small concerts, shows, movie nights, corporate parties, holiday parties, birthdays, and more. services.desc: Join Airbase Georgia for a memorable evening in our authentic World War II hangar. Enjoy live music by the Peachtree Jazz Edition, dinner, dancing, and silent auction opportunities while celebrating our nation’s past, present, and future. Proceeds benefit Airbase Georgia’s mission to educate, honor, and inspire through the preservation and presentation of World War II aviation history and educational programs. services.name: Traron Formation Clinic
services.desc: Please join us for a Commemorative Air Force TRARON Formation clinic at EAA Chapter 976 at the West Georgia Regional Airport (CTJ) in Carrollton, GA from October 1st-4th, 2026. All Commemorative Air Force TRARON members are welcome. Training will be offered in the T-6/SNJ/Harvard, Beech 18/C45, and T-34 Mentor. Pilots seeking formation training in other aircraft shall contact the organizers before registering to confirm sufficient and appropriate aircraft are expected. Participants are required to be Commemorative Air Force and CAF TRARON members prior to arriving at the clinic. Arrival day is scheduled for Thursday, October 1st and the clinic will begin with a mandatory safety briefing

blurb: Airbase Georgia offers a variety of living history flight experiences in our aircraft. Feel the g-forces from the 1,500 horsepower Rolls Royce Merlin engine in our P-51 Mustang “Red Nose”, or transport yourself back to the Battle of Midway in the gunner’s seat of our ultra-rare SBD-5 Dauntless!
